scope: Top-level shared-inout four-state net-resolution contract (B): exhaustive declared-state transition walk and continuous waveform convergence in actual Minecraft 26.2, on two independent fixtures, against an independent frozen oracle.
contract: Each resolved bus bit is (value,present); a top-level bit contributes an explicit external caller pair. Valid observations return Boolean; Floating (Z), Contention (X) and ProtocolViolation remain explicit errors. Matched representatives (caller == present && declared) are used so every electrical class is exercised through transitions.

method.transition_walk: Hierholzer Eulerian circuit over the complete digraph on 64 declared states with self-loops: one 4097-vertex walk covers all 4096 ordered (before->after) transitions exactly once.
method.representatives: protocol_matched (caller==present&&declared) per declared state, so the walk lands in every Value/Contention/Floating class rather than masking 16 states as ProtocolViolation.
method.oracle: pure-Python multi-driver resolution reference (no HDL simulator), independent of the Rust compiler; 8192 rows = 64x64x2 (before,after,phase,value).
method.waveform_convergence: reconstruct the driver's per-poll read_state dicts from the raw RCON log (marker-pair grouping on the first lamp read), then require the maximal identical suffix of the poll sequence to be >= REQUIRED_STABLE_POLLS (5). This is the same fixed-point guarantee poll_until_quiescent enforces; no extra settling allowance.
method.game_protocol: frozen circuit_conformance.py (run/poll_until_quiescent/read_state/read_relay_state); driver only monkeypatches read_state (adds channel/readback/external-pad reads) and read_relay_state (bounded re-forceload retry on transient RegionNotReady - an environment retry, not a settling change).

fixture1.source: tests/fixtures/resolved-inout.sv (two internal tri-state writers + one external writer)

fixture2.source: fixture2/fixture.sv (writer + inverted writer driving ~data + external; same port contract, different netlist and state->class mapping)

limits: Qualifies the top-level shared-inout four-state net-resolution contract for the specified binary valid domain (Value/Contention/Floating/ProtocolViolation) across all 4096 declared-state transitions and continuous waveform convergence, on two independent netlists, against an independent oracle. Does not close gap 5 (Native HDL) or any broad row: operators beyond the integral subset, unsized literals, int/integer signals, non-integral/>64-bit parameter types, >32-bit constant arithmetic, and the 128-level hierarchy-depth / no-output-module rejections remain unqualified. Raw RCON logs are retained on disk under target/ (gitignored) and referenced by SHA256; they are not committed due to size.
raw_log_retention: The two raw RCON logs (3.53 GB and 3.21 GB) and the per-vector transition results (12.7 MB and 12.4 MB) remain on disk at the paths above with the recorded SHA256. An independent reviewer with the same machine can re-run fixture1/transition-audit.py and fixture1/waveform-audit.py (and the fixture2 copies) against those logs to reproduce every accepted result.
